answer.text: The two versions conflict. The English says a 10% service charge is added to all lunch orders, while the original Japanese says the 10% service charge at lunch applies only to customers who order a course. The page notes the English is auto-translated and to check with the restaurant.

citations.quote: A 10% service charge will be added. (A 10% service charge will be added to all lunch orders.)
サービス料10％を頂戴しております。 （ランチ利用時はコースご注文のお客様のみサービス料10％を頂戴しております）
